$comment: Chikangawa Hills theme guardrails. Every logic-bearing change a phase makes on purpose must be declared here with a reason, so the user can review them in one place. The phase checklist is: `pnpm hills:logic-diff` must exit 0.

newFiles.reason: Phase 1: pure sky rules (Light=day, Dark=night, Auto=Malawi clock) and the pre-paint script text; tested against each other in tools/hills/__tests__/sky.test.mts
